---
name: Independent reproduction report
about: Report an attempt to reproduce the fixture run, a live run, or the 2026-06-30 receipt on your own machine
title: "Reproduction: "
labels: ["reproduction"]
---

## Environment

OS, Node version, npm version. For live runs, which vendor keys were present.

## Commit/SHA

The thecouncil commit you ran against (full SHA).

## Command

The exact command(s) you ran, copied from the README Reproduce block or the eval CLI docs.

## Expected result

What the documentation says should happen (quote it).

## Observed result

What actually happened. Paste the command tail verbatim.

## Differences

Every place expected and observed disagree. "None" is a valid answer and is still worth filing.

## Evidence attached

Logs, `sample_outputs/` reports, or eval run records attached to this issue. A report without evidence is a claim, not a reproduction.
